The '''Cantros system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Saijo sector/Legends|Saijo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Cantros 7]].<ref name="SW93" />
